answer.recommendation: Schedule Sam Lee's three 45-minute sessions on January 14 in the first three available morning start times: technical at 09:00, product at 10:00, and team at 11:00. Each session fits within an available start time and none overlap. This leaves 13:00 and 14:00 open as backups if any interviewer cannot make a morning slot. Confirm with the interviewers before sending invitations, since the packet lists only start times and does not say which interviewer is assigned to each session.
quality_notes: The work packet lists general interviewer start times, not per-interviewer availability, so the assignment of interviewers to sessions is unverified.
Sam Lee does not appear in the visible candidate directory (C1-C4), so the candidate record could not be cross-checked.
No colleague was contacted; the schedule relies only on the work packet.
The 09:00, 10:00, and 11:00 slots are back-to-back at 45 minutes each, leaving a 15-minute gap between sessions, which is within the packet's stated constraints.
Backups at 13:00 and 14:00 are provided but were not confirmed as available for any specific interviewer.
